title: Insight
content: Home | Solution | Insight Solution Turn Experimental Data into Insight Make your experimental knowledge usable across every project, team, and decision. The Platform Connects Data, Models, and Context The Citrine Platform helps researchers uncover new insight, innovation leaders make better decisions, and organizations preserve hard-won knowledge so it can be reused, scaled, and applied faster across the entire development lifecycle. In complex product development, valuable knowledge is often trapped in spreadsheets, reports, legacy systems, and individual experience. The result is slower learning, repeated experiments, and decisions made without a clear view of trade-offs. The Citrine Platform gives customers a unified way to connect data, models, documents, and technical context — so teams can learn faster and act with more confidence. Connect Data Unify experimental results, formulations, and process data across systems and teams. Surface Insight Apply AI to reveal patterns, trade-offs, and relationships that are invisible in raw data. Preserve Knowledge Capture reasoning, context, and expertise so it remains usable long after a project ends. Accelerate Decisions Align technical and business stakeholders around shared evidence and explicit trade-offs. “You’re essentially institutionalizing the knowledge that you are generating in a way that can be easily accessed and used by your next generation of scientists or formulators coming in to the team.” — David Cranfill, Director of Innovation and Technology, Huntsman Polyurethanes Help Researchers Find Patterns They Would Otherwise Miss Experimental data contains relationships that aren’t visible in any single spreadsheet or report. The Citrine Platform applies AI to surface the non-obvious connections between formulation, process, and performance — giving your researchers a significant analytical advantage from day one of a new project. Uncover Hidden Relationships Identify non-obvious connections between formulation choices, process parameters, and end-use performance. Reveal Critical Raw Materials Understand which raw materials matter most — which raw materials cannot be easily substituted — before committing resources to a development path or deciding on stocking levels. Identify Trade-Offs Earlier Surface cost, performance, supply resilience, and sustainability trade-offs before scale-up to production. Discuss these with your customers. Build on Prior Experiments Ensure every new project automatically inherits the learning from previous work — so your team spends less time rediscovering and more time advancing. Uncover driving forces Make Trade-Offs Visible Before You Commit Time and Budget The Citrine Platform gives innovation leaders the ability to visualize trade-offs across cost, performance, compliance, and supply constraints — turning abstract debates into evidence-based alignment. Compare Options Rigorously Evaluate formulation or process alternatives across multiple dimensions simultaneously — cost, performance, compliance, and supply risk — in a single view. Visualize Instead of Debate Replace lengthy internal debates with clear visual representations of trade-off spaces. Shared evidence accelerates alignment between technical and business stakeholders. Confident Go/No-Go Calls Make stage-gate decisions backed by explicit, shared reasoning — not gut instinct or incomplete data — so you move faster and with greater conviction. Keep Expertise in the Company, Even When People Move On Institutional knowledge should be a durable organizational asset — not a fragile dependency tied to individual tenure. When experienced employees retire or transition, the insights they carry shouldn’t leave with them. The Citrine Platform transforms tacit expertise into structured, searchable, reusable knowledge that new team members can access from day one. Protect Against Brain Drain Hard-won knowledge no longer walks out the door when experienced researchers retire or move to new roles. Reduce Tribal Knowledge Risk Move beyond informal knowledge networks. Make critical technical insights explicit, searchable, and independently accessible. Accelerate Onboarding Help new team members get productive faster by giving them direct access to contextualized prior work and institutional reasoning. “As you’re having more experienced employees approach retirement and you have new hires coming on, the AI enables — really, the new employees especially — to gather the information from a broad range of sources and have it at their fingertips so that they can start to perform as an employee with several more years of experience almost out of the gate.” — David Thomas, Director of Research Development, Syensqo Build Resilience With What-If Analysis Prepare for Disruption Before It Becomes a Crisis Resilience improves when teams can test scenarios before supply, cost, or regulatory changes force a reaction.
